//: Build only when this app, or the shared packages it imports, actually changed. Exit 0 tells Vercel to skip; a non-zero exit tells it to build. `.` is this app's directory (the project's Root Directory) and ../../packages is the shared code. Anything else in the repo — the migration plan, another app, a script — leaves this one alone. If HEAD^ does not exist, git exits non-zero and the build runs, which is the safe way round.
